minor.issue: Returns 54 metiers instead of >100 as mentioned in requirements. This may be expected based on current data.

issues: First question shows text-only choices without images (local paths /q1-groupe.png don't exist). This is expected per agent_to_agent_context_note - labels are shown instead.

backend_api_tests: All visual questions have type 'visual' or 'ranking'
All visual questions have choices with labels and values
All visual questions have category field for headers
POST /api/dclic/submit returns profile with vertus_profile (all required fields)
vertus_profile.penseurs has orientaux and occidentaux arrays
POST /api/dclic/submit returns profile with compass (functioning compass)
POST /api/dclic/submit returns profile with profile_narrative containing portrait

3 intro cards displayed: 'Je cherche mon job', 'Au-delà du diplôme', 'Je cherche encore...'

Clicking a visual choice auto-advances to next question

critical_code_review_comments: dclic_data.py correctly implements VISUAL_QUESTIONS with 26 questions across 8 blocs (energie, perception, decision, structure, disc, ennea, riasec, vertus)
dclic_scoring.py correctly implements compute_profile() supporting both visual (v1-v12, r1-r8, vv1-vv6) and legacy (q1-q15) formats
Frontend DclicTestPage.jsx correctly handles visual and ranking question types with auto-advance on visual choice click
GPT-5.2 integration for profile_narrative generation working (20-40 second response time as expected)
test_credentials: No authentication required for D'CLIC PRO test (public access at /test-dclic)
seed_data_creation: None - test creates its own data via POST /api/dclic/submit
context_for_next_testing_agent: D'CLIC PRO Visual Questionnaire (GitHub integration) fully tested. The questionnaire has 26 questions: v1-v12 (MBTI+DISC+Ennéagramme), r1-r8 (RIASEC), vv1-vv6 (Vertus). Question types are 'visual' (2 choices, auto-advance on click) and 'ranking' (4+ choices to order). POST /api/dclic/submit takes 20-40 seconds due to GPT-5.2 narrative generation. Sample visual answers format: v1=E, v2=E, v3=N, v4=N1,N2,S1,S2 (ranking), etc. Frontend flow: /test-dclic → Commencer → Birthdate (Suivant) → Target Job (Suivant) → Education (Démarrer) → Visual Questionnaire (26 questions).
